tools.name: get_notification_preferences
tools.description: Read account defaults or project overrides and effective notification policies. Personal affects your email; shared affects team destinations.

tools.name: update_notification_preferences
tools.description: Update channel modes or daily email time and IANA timezone. Project overrides may inherit. Shared settings require account owner or project owner/admin. Monitoring continues; mandatory system emails are separate.

tools.name: pause_notifications
tools.description: Pause selected channels until a future UTC instant, or null for until resumed. Account pauses win over project settings. Explicitly opt in to health-check alerts during the pause. Personal supports email only.

tools.name: resume_notifications
tools.description: Resume selected channels at the chosen account/project scope, preserving delivery modes. An account pause still overrides project resume. Suppressed alerts are not replayed.

tools.name: get_public_status_page
tools.description: Read a project's public status settings and share URL. Owners receive configuration; collaborators receive only the published link and title.

tools.name: save_public_status_page
tools.description: Save or publish/unpublish a public status page. Owner only. Explicit selections expose names and 30-day availability for chosen checks; other projects must share the same owner and account. Anchor project must be first. New checks remain private.

tools.name: list_public_status_page_options
tools.description: List a bounded page of same-owner/account projects and checks eligible for status publication. Owner only; continue with next_cursor.

tools.name: preview_public_status_page
tools.description: Preview the saved public projection, including unpublished settings. Owner only. Reads existing availability; never executes checks or exposes diagnostic details.

tools.name: list_analytics_flows
tools.description: List this project's named acquisition and activation flows, including archived definitions.

tools.name: save_analytics_flow
tools.description: Create or replace a project flow with two to eight ordered steps and exact origins. Owner/admin only. Edits start a new report version.

tools.name: archive_analytics_flow
tools.description: Archive a project flow, stopping new capture while retaining aggregate reports. Owner/admin only.

tools.name: get_analytics_flow_report
tools.description: Read aggregate reached steps, drop-off, elapsed time, sources and unlinked coverage for full UTC days. Observations do not prove backend business outcomes.

tools.name: smoke
tools.description: Run the end-to-end smoke flow for a hosted project.

tools.description: Run local agent-oriented DebugBundle analysis.
